create_Batch_tensor: create a Batch object wrapping a single PyTorch tensor with an index value
create_Batch_tensors: create a Batch object wrapping a tuple of PyTorch tensors with an index value
scatter_microbatch: split a mini-batch tensor or tuple of tensors into multiple micro-batches using scatter
gather_microbatch: concatenate a list of Batch micro-batches back into a single mini-batch using gather
check_tensor_input: validate that an input is a PyTorch tensor or tuple of tensors using check
